messages:
maya: Heads up — since the canary rollout yesterday we've seen a small spike in WS reconnects in eu-west-1. Suspect resume/TTL mismatch causing duplicate sessions & double billing.
raj: Any logs/traces? sample request id?
maya: example from client header:
```http
GET /ws?resume=true
Resume-Token: abc123
Resume-TS: 1700000000
Resume-Client-Host: 10.1.2.3
Resume-TTL: 0
```
maya: Server logic expects Resume-TTL >= 300. Clients getting 0 then immediately attempt fresh auth => double sessions.
ben: That's the new sticky-route header normalization we rolled out. It zeroes TTL for legacy local proxies if no session store present.
lisa: Console/graph shows reconnect spike aligns with the canary window 02:10–02:40 UTC. Sampling rate 10% so raw events undercount.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: alert: eu-west-1/ws/connection_reconnects rate increased 4.8x — paging eng-platform.
raj: Can we add a quick mitigation? e.g., treat TTL=0 as "unknown" and keep old default (300s) until backend confirms?
ben: quick patch would be to interpret 0 as "defer to route policy" — I can prototype a hotfix for the dedicated proxies.
maya: Also need console UX for rollouts: show per-route header normalization state + per-canary telemetry so SREs can eyeball behavioral deltas.
lisa: Agree — current console only shows aggregate reconnects, not how many were tagged with Resume-TTL=0. Need a tag/filter.
ben: For telemetry we should emit a tag: resume_ttl_source=(client|proxy-default|route-normalizer) and counter for resume_ttl_zero.
maya: I'll open a follow-up doc for console change. For now can we flip canary back to 0% in eu-west until patch?
deploy-bot: rollback scheduled for canary flag ws-sticky-normalization in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-22T03:05Z :white_check_mark:
ben: prototype patch idea:
```go
if resumeTTL == 0 {
  resumeTTL = route.DefaultResumeTTL // 300s
  metrics.Counter("resume_ttl_zero_deferred").Inc()
}
```
raj: If we do that hotfix, let's also emit a debug log with request_id and route_id for the first 1000 occurrences so we can repro without full sampling.
lisa: After rollback we'll compare pre/post graphs and run the A/B with TTL-explicitness flag in the client SDK.
maya: thanks all — can we track ownership? ben for patch, lisa for console ticket, raj for logs collection. I'll coordinate the rollback verification. :thumbsup:
